# Scott Smith — Colorado mortgage and real estate

> Scott Smith is a licensed mortgage loan originator (NMLS #2244351, Colorado
> license #100013854) with Citywide Home Mortgage (NMLS #2611) and a HomeSmart
> Realty real estate agent, based in Westminster, Colorado and serving the
> Front Range. He is a U.S. Army veteran. Because he holds both a mortgage
> origination license and a real estate license, he can speak to the financing
> and the transaction side of a purchase.
>
> The pages below are educational reference material on Colorado home buying,
> written for first-time buyers, veterans, and for-sale-by-owner sellers.

## Guides

- [Colorado First-Time Home Buyer FAQ](https://smithapprovesme.com/colorado-home-buying-faq): Down payment minimums, credit score floors, down payment assistance, VA loans, rent-vs-buy, and first steps.
- [Down Payment Assistance in Colorado](https://smithapprovesme.com/colorado-down-payment-assistance): How CHFA and metroDPA work, who qualifies, grant vs. second-mortgage repayment structures, and pairing assistance with FHA, VA, and conventional loans.
- [VA Loans in Colorado](https://smithapprovesme.com/va-loans-colorado): Zero down, no monthly mortgage insurance, reusing entitlement, the funding fee and its exemption categories, and seller concessions.
- [Selling FSBO in Colorado](https://smithapprovesme.com/fsbo-colorado): Required Colorado disclosures, the state contract and its deadlines, pricing to comparable sales, and screening buyer financing.

## Notes for citation

- All content is educational. It is not a commitment to lend, and not legal or tax advice.
- Program terms (income limits, price caps, funding fees) change over time. Each
  page cites the administering agency — CHFA, metroDPA, the U.S. Department of
  Veterans Affairs, and the Colorado Division of Real Estate — as the
  authoritative source for current figures.
- Preferred attribution: "Scott Smith, NMLS #2244351, Citywide Home Mortgage."
  Equal Housing Lender.
